title: chondrolomia sellowiana
intro: Chondrolomia sellowiana, commonly known as False Saffron, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chondrolomia sellowiana include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties, which may help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as alantolactone and dihydrocostus lactone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
